partes.p: Let $A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$; then $\det(A) = 2$ and $A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 1 & a & b \\ -1 & -2 & 5 \\ 2 & 2 & -6 \end{bmatrix}$; find $a$ and $b$.
Solve the system $AX = B$, where $X = \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ -2 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}$.
